product.name: Monoprice Aria In-Ceiling Speaker 8-inch Subwoofer with Dual Voice Coil (each)
product.description: With all of the ceiling speakers available what makes our Aria 2.1 system stand out? Simply put, it is their great sound and ease of installation. The Aria 2.1 system features an 8" passive subwoofer and a pair of 3" satellite speakers. Unlike other passive systems, where wires need to be run from the amplifier to each individual speaker, installation is simplified by running only a single speaker wire to the subwoofer, then shorter wires from the subwoofer to the individual satellite speakers.The subwoofer has a 12dB crossover that splits the audio signal so it uses only frequencies below 200Hz and sends all frequencies above 200Hz to the satellites. The system is designed to be powered by amplifiers with 50 to 200 watts of power, making it well‑suited for most home theater audio systems. Need more bass? Add another subwoofer. Need more coverage for a large room? Add another pair of satellite speakers. It doesn't get any more simple than that.True 2.1 SystemSlim BezelEasy InstallModularTrue 2.1 System: The subwoofer employs a 2‑way, 12db crossover at 200Hz, so it uses all frequencies below 200Hz and sends all frequencies above 200Hz to the satellite speakers.Slim Bezel: The slim bezel on the paintable speaker grill allows these speakers to more easily blend in with the ceiling, making for a system that's heard and not seen.Easy Install: Rather than needing to run separate wires from the amplifier to each speaker, only a single, 4‑conductor wire needs to run from the amp to the subwoofer, then a shorter pair of 2‑conductor wires run from the sub to the satellites.Modular: The system is designed to be extended by using additional subwoofers and/or satellite speakers. Need more bass? Add another subwoofer. Need more coverage for a large room? Add another pair of satellite speakers. It doesn't get any more simple than that. Great Sound Above the GroundEnjoy rich and full sound in any room of your home without bulky and unsightly speaker boxes.
